end.summary: Practised naming radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment, and sector.
end.parentNote: Dev practised identifying circle parts using boundary, centre, chord, and radius clues. They correctly described a diameter as a chord through the centre and recognised an arc as a curved part of the circle. The sector–segment mix-up continued through the last example; at home, use a paper circle to shade one region bounded by two radii and an arc (sector) and one bounded by a chord and an arc (segment).
